faq.question: What is the main difference between Windows 11 Home and Pro?
faq.answer: Windows 11 Pro includes all the features of Home, plus additional business and security tools like BitLocker encryption, Remote Desktop, and Hyper-V for virtualization.

faq.question: Is this a lifetime license?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a one-time purchase for a lifetime retail license for one computer. It does not expire.

faq.question: How will I receive the product key?
faq.answer: The product key is delivered instantly to your email address after the purchase is complete.

faq.answer: Absolutely. As long as the total number of activated machines does not exceed five, you can use them wherever you need.

faq.question: What does an OEM key mean?
faq.answer: An OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) key is typically tied to the motherboard of the first PC it's installed on and cannot be transferred to another computer.

faq.question: Can I upgrade to Windows 11 Pro for free with this license?
faq.answer: Yes, if your computer meets the minimum system requirements for Windows 11, this Windows 10 Pro license allows for a free upgrade to Windows 11 Pro.

data.description: Enterprise-grade Windows 10 for medium & large organisations.

faq.question: Is this version suitable for a personal computer?
faq.answer: While it can be installed on a personal PC, Windows 10 Enterprise is designed for IT professionals in medium to large organizations and includes many advanced features a typical home user would not need.

faq.question: What is the main benefit of Enterprise over Pro?
faq.answer: The Enterprise edition offers more advanced security and management features like DirectAccess, AppLocker, and Credential Guard, which are critical for managing large fleets of computers in a corporate environment.

customerReviews.comment: Exactly what we needed for our test environment. DirectAccess and AppLocker work as expected. Legitimate key.

data.name: windows-10-enterprise-ltsc-2021
data.title: Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2021
data.description: Long-Term Servicing Channel release—10 years support.
features: System Guard with SMM Firmware Protection

faq.question: What does LTSC mean?
faq.answer: LTSC stands for Long-Term Servicing Channel. This version of Windows receives security updates for 10 years but does not receive the frequent feature updates, making it extremely stable for mission-critical systems.

faq.question: Does LTSC include the Microsoft Store or Cortana?
faq.answer: No, LTSC versions are stripped-down and do not include many consumer-facing apps like the Microsoft Store, Cortana, or Microsoft Edge (though the 2021 version includes Edge).

customerReviews.comment: The only choice for our control systems. We need stability above all, and LTSC 2021 delivers. No bloatware, no surprise updates. It just works.
